findings.entity: hands of the person at the table
findings.description: At 00:01-00:02 a pair of hands rests at the top of the frame (one showing the white shirt cuff) while a third hand simultaneously enters from the lower left to manipulate the front cup. Only one person (the man in the blue suit) is seated at the table, and only two hands are shown before and after, leaving the third hand unexplained.

The large embossed gold coin sitting on the middle cup from 00:00-00:02 appears as a silver/white coin at 00:03, although neither hand touched that cup in the interim; the metal color change is unexplained.

Once the man's upper body is visible (00:05-00:09) he wears both a black bow tie at the collar and a red necktie hanging down simultaneously, an implausible combination that reads as a generation artifact rather than intentional styling.
